name: neutrino_sum
formula: Σm_ν = m_1 + sqrt(m_1² + Δm²_21) + sqrt(m_1² + Δm²_31)
app_psc_precision_str: 0.0853 eV > 0.064 eV (DESI DR2 + CMB, 95%, LambdaCDM): TENSION; the DR2 bound lies below the 0.075 eV P.4 gate but is model-dependent

extra.desi_dr2_source: DESI DR2 BAO + CMB, LambdaCDM, 95% (arXiv:2503.14738); < 0.16 eV under w0wa
extra.note: Σm_ν = 0.0853 eV exceeds the DESI DR2 + CMB ΛCDM bound of 0.064 eV, which already lies below the registered 0.075 eV P.4 gate. The row is a TENSION rather than a gate crossing because the bound is ΛCDM-model-dependent, not a definitive measurement. The retired Planck 2018 0.12 eV bound no longer yields a PASS.
